notes:
Account snapshot: Lodestar Vector Commons (search platform for large enterprise knowledge bases). Interested in replacing a brittle Elastic+BM25 first-pass with vector retrieval + cross-encoder rerank.

Key signals from calls:
- 2026-02-03 discovery: tech & product teams present. quote: "we need predictable p95 under load, can't spike to 1s per query".
- 2026-02-10 demo: SE ran sample retrieval against 500k doc corpus. Redwood retrieval looked promising but they asked for connector-specific benchmarks.

Scale & perf requirements (customer-provided):
- Index size: 20M documents, ~100M vectors (1536 dim).
- Expected steady QPS: 150 r/s (peak 300 r/s).
- SLO: end-to-end p95 <= 220ms for search+rerank in production; aspirational p95 <= 150ms.
- Cost target: ~$0.0008 - $0.002 per query (including retrieval + rerank), very cost-sensitive.

Vector DB / connector preferences & asks:
- Primary options: wants to validate Pinecone and pgvector (self-host) first, Weaviate for schema/fusion considered. Elastic hybrid search still in play as fallback.
- Connector must support: bulk upsert >100k vectors/hour, per-shard upsert monitoring, consistent id mapping to original doc chunks, partial reindex with delta updates, real-time delete semantics.
- Expectation: SDK + native connector (Python/Go) with robust retries and idempotency for ingestion. Also need provenance metadata passthrough for audit.

Retrieval + Rerank pipeline requirements:
- Candidate retrieval: ANN latency target <60ms at 100k+ candidates/min. Need ability to tune candidate pool size (default 100 -> 500).
- Reranker: cross-encoder running on Redwood Dedicated or Private (condensed model). Must support batch rerank (N to 1) and GPU quantized variants. Reranker latency budget ~80-120ms for top-10.
- Hybrid search: BM25 + vector scoring, scoring weights configurable per route.

Operational & integration asks:
- Bulk import connectors for S3/Glue + DB sync (delta ingestion).
- Metrics hooks: latency by stage (embedding, retrieval, rerank), token costs, cold vs warm cache breakdown.
- QA/eval harness: Redwood evals for regression alerts tied to our golden prompt set (10k queries).
- Fallbacks: automatic routing to smaller quantized model when Dedicated saturated; want Canary rollout ability.

Security/compliance notes:
- Data residency: EU customer data must remain in eu-priv region.
- Strong requirements for KMS integration and audit logs retention 3+ years.
- Must support enterprise SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning.

POC plan discussed:
- Week 0: share sample dataset (~200k docs) and tokenized chunks (drive link).
- Week 1: Redwood runs retrieval+rerank perf matrix on Pinecone and pgvector (self-host on customer infra). Measure p50/p95/p99 and cost per query.
- Week 2: ingestion stress test (100k vectors/hour), observe upsert latencies and backpressure behavior.
- Week 3: integration of reranker on dedicated small GPU pool; run golden set evals.

Open questions / risks called out by customer:
- pgvector operational cost vs Pinecone managed; need TCO comparison that includes network egress, shard ops, maintenance.
- Reranker compute costs — would we host reranker on Redwood Dedicated or let Lodestar self-host? prefer Redwood-run for ops simplicity but need clear pricing.
- Connector maturity for partial reindex and soft deletes (current pgvector script is brittle).

Immediate next steps (agreed on call):
- SE Diego to deliver ingestion benchmark template + sample runner by 2026-02-16 (linked).
- AE Samira to schedule infra deep dive with Lodestar infra lead for 2026-02-18.
- Send SSO/iso27001 artifacts (security FAQ + SOC2 links).

Short notes / CRM shorthand:
- "likes the fallback routing idea" — product team.
- Legal flagged data residency; procurement will need enterprise contract.
- Budget: internal approval pending; estimated ARR band discussed.
- Action: prioritize Pinecone + pgvector tests, include cost-per-query calc in POC deliverable.
